purpose: Store durable technical facts from authoritative or licensed sources independently from mutable commerce feeds.

authority.grade: A_MANUFACTURER | A_REGULATOR | B_CERTIFICATION_BODY | B_DISTRIBUTOR_AUTHORIZED | C_CATALOG_INFERRED | D_UNVERIFIED

principles: Manufacturer technical evidence can verify product facts but does not itself prove project suitability.
A commercial listing never upgrades inferred technical fields to authoritative evidence.
Regional model differences must be tracked; a global model-family specification can remain REVIEW for local regulatory applicability.
Compliance documents and installation suitability are separate from marketing availability.
